trap-nonspeakable.notes: THREE MATH FLAGS (not traps, reported not fixed). (1) AXIOM 3 IS ILL-TYPED AND OMITS ITS OWN SUBJECT. It reads 'The Frobenius form lambda satisfies mu . Delta = (Delta tensor id) . alpha . (id tensor mu)' - lambda does not appear in the equation at all, and the two sides do not compose: the left is A -> A, while the right runs A tensor A tensor A -> A tensor A -> A tensor A tensor A. The standard Frobenius relation is Delta . mu = (mu tensor id) . (id tensor Delta) = (id tensor mu) . (Delta tensor id), all A tensor A -> A tensor A. (2) THE ANTIPODE IS UNCONSTRAINED. S appears in the sextuple and is named in axiom 2, but no axiom relates it to anything - the Hopf antipode condition mu . (S tensor id) . Delta = eta . epsilon is missing, so S is free data. What axiom 2 actually states (epsilon . mu = u . (epsilon tensor epsilon)) is multiplicativity of the counit, not a Hopf compatibility involving S. (3) Axiom 5 introduces Phi = lambda . mu, which is definitionally the same morphism axiom 4 already named ev; one of the two names should go.
